description: Automatically turn production failures into reproducible eval cases with grading rubrics — then run them.
notes: Shared kit landed mid-build; re-targeted to the real shared/kit.js contract.

notes.note: 'Every production failure is a free test case nobody writes down' is the best sentence in the agent-infra batch, and the failure-to-eval flywheel genuinely compounds. Crowded (Braintrust, LangSmith), but the private-failure-ingestion wedge is a real distribution idea. This one I'd actually fund.
Generate-eval-case produces case with rubric; library modal works; zero errors.
Normalized score schema: iteration-2 worker used thesis/magic_moment/demo_legibility/value_prop/ceiling; mapped to startup/originality/quality/usefulness/tech respectively.

iteration_notes.change: Failure cards now show the agent's actual production quote (the original sin); failing grades get a ship-blocking banner and one-click save-to-library
